# Production Runbook
## Garment-Sourcing Marketplace – Hetzner Cloud Infrastructure
**Last Updated:** [Date]  
**Primary Contacts:** [Developer 1], [Developer 2]  
**Escalation Path:** [CTO/Manager Name, Phone, Email]

---

## 1. SYSTEM OVERVIEW

### 1.1 Production Architecture
```
app-1 (95.217.111.111)            db-1 (95.217.111.112)
├── Laravel 10                    ├── MySQL 8.0
├── PHP 8.2-FPM                   └── Private network only
├── nginx (port 80/443)
├── Supervisor (queue worker)
├── certbot (TLS)
├── Uptime Kuma (port 3001)
└── Backblaze B2 sync (rclone)
```

### 1.2 Critical Credentials (Store in 1Password/LastPass)
- **Hetzner Cloud Console:** https://console.hetzner.cloud
- **Backblaze B2 Bucket:** [Bucket Name]
- **Telegram Alert Group:** [Group Link]
- **Server SSH Keys:** [Location of private keys]
- **MySQL root password:** [Password]
- **Laravel `.env` file:** [Location]

### 1.3 Daily Health Check (8:30 AM Dhaka Time)
1. Visit https://status.yourdomain.com (Uptime Kuma dashboard)
2. Verify all services show **green** status
3. Check Telegram for overnight alerts
4. Visit https://yourdomain.com – ensure site loads

**Success:** Dashboard all green, no unread alerts, website loads.  
**Stop & Escalate:** Any red status or website down → Section 7.

---

## 2. ROUTINE MAINTENANCE

### 2.1 Deploy Code Updates (Weekly, Tuesday 10 AM)
```bash
# SSH to app-1
ssh -i ~/.ssh/hetzner_key app-1

# Navigate to application
cd /var/www/your-app

# Pull latest code
git pull origin main

# Install dependencies
composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader

# Clear caches
php artisan optimize:clear
php artisan view:cache
php artisan route:cache
php artisan config:cache

# Restart PHP and queue worker
sudo systemctl restart php8.2-fpm
sudo supervisorctl restart all

# Verify deployment
curl -I https://yourdomain.com
```

**Success:** HTTP 200 response, site functions normally.  
**Stop & Escalate:** Error messages during git pull or artisan commands → Section 7.

### 2.2 Renew TLS Certificates (Automatic, verify monthly)
```bash
# Check certificate expiry
sudo certbot certificates

# Manual renewal test (if needed)
sudo certbot renew --dry-run

# Actual renewal
sudo certbot renew
sudo systemctl reload nginx
```

**Success:** `certbot certificates` shows expiry >30 days away.  
**Stop & Escalate:** Renewal fails → Section 7.2.

### 2.3 Check Disk Space (Every Monday)
```bash
# On both servers
df -h

# Check largest directories
sudo du -sh /var/* | sort -hr
```

**Success:** `/` partition has >20% free space.  
**Stop & Escalate:** <10% free space → Section 7.3.

---

## 3. BACKUP PROCEDURES

### 3.1 Verify Daily Backups (Every Morning)
```bash
# SSH to db-1
ssh -i ~/.ssh/hetzner_key db-1

# Check backup cron log
tail -20 /var/log/backup.log

# Expected log entry:
# "Backup completed and uploaded to B2"

# List recent backups in B2
rclone ls backblaze:your-bucket-name/db-backups/
```

**Success:** Today's backup file exists in B2, log shows no errors.  
**Stop & Escalate:** No backup in last 24 hours → Section 7.4.

### 3.2 Restore Database (Emergency Only)
```bash
# Download latest backup from B2 to db-1
rclone copy backblaze:your-bucket-name/db-backups/latest.sql.gz /tmp/

# Decompress
gzip -d /tmp/latest.sql.gz

# Stop application traffic first!
# On app-1: sudo systemctl stop php8.2-fpm

# Restore to MySQL
mysql -u root -p < /tmp/latest.sql

# Start application
# On app-1: sudo systemctl start php8.2-fpm
```

**Success:** Database restored, site functions.  
**Stop & Escalate:** Restore fails or data inconsistency → Section 7.4.

---

## 4. MONITORING & ALERTS

### 4.1 Uptime Kuma Status Page
- URL: https://status.yourdomain.com
- Login: [Username/Password]
- Monitors: HTTP(S) on app-1, MySQL on db-1, disk space, certificates

### 4.2 Telegram Alerts
- Group: [Telegram Group Link]
- Expected alerts: Certificate expiry (14 days), downtime, backup failures
- **Never ignore:** "Certificate Expiry" or "Database Down" alerts

### 4.3 Manual Service Checks
```bash
# Check nginx
sudo systemctl status nginx

# Check PHP
sudo systemctl status php8.2-fpm

# Check MySQL (on db-1)
sudo systemctl status mysql

# Check queue worker
sudo supervisorctl status
```

**Success:** All services show "active (running)".  
**Stop & Escalate:** Any service not running → Section 7.1.

---

## 5. SECURITY UPDATES

### 5.1 Monthly Security Updates (First Thursday)
```bash
# On both servers
sudo apt update
sudo apt upgrade -y

# Reboot if kernel updated (one server at a time)
sudo reboot

# Verify services return
# Wait 2 minutes, then check:
sudo systemctl status nginx php8.2-fpm mysql
```

**Success:** Updates install without errors, services restart automatically.  
**Stop & Escalate:** Server doesn't come back online → Section 7.5.

---

## 6. TROUBLESHOOTING FLOWCHART

```
Problem Detected
        ↓
Check Uptime Kuma → Which service? → Check corresponding logs
        ↓                                ↓
Telegram Alert? → Yes → Follow alert instructions
        ↓
No → Basic triage:
1. Can you SSH to server? No → Hetzner Console reboot
2. Service status check (Section 4.3)
3. Check logs:
   - nginx: sudo tail -50 /var/log/nginx/error.log
   - PHP: sudo tail -50 /var/log/php8.2-fpm.log
   - MySQL: sudo tail -50 /var/log/mysql/error.log
4. Last change? Code deploy? Update?
```

---

## 7. EMERGENCY PROCEDURES

### 7.1 Website Down (All Services)
1. **Check:** https://status.yourdomain.com
2. **SSH to app-1:** `ssh app-1`
3. **Restart services:**
   ```bash
   sudo systemctl restart nginx php8.2-fpm
   sudo supervisorctl restart all
   ```
4. **Wait 60 seconds**, check site
5. **Still down?** Restart server:
   ```bash
   sudo reboot
   ```
6. **Wait 3 minutes**, check site
7. **STOP & ESCALATE** to [CTO Name]

### 7.2 Certificate Renewal Failed
1. **Manual renew:**
   ```bash
   sudo certbot renew --force-renewal
   sudo systemctl reload nginx
   ```
2. **Check:** `sudo certbot certificates`
3. **Still failing?** Use HTTP-only temporarily:
   ```bash
   # Edit nginx config
   sudo nano /etc/nginx/sites-available/your-app
   # Comment out SSL lines (443 port, SSL cert paths)
   # Change listen 443 ssl to listen 80
   sudo systemctl reload nginx
   ```
4. **ESCALATE immediately** – site without HTTPS is temporary fix

### 7.3 Disk Full
```bash
# Check what's consuming space
sudo du -sh /var/* | sort -hr

# Common fixes:
# 1. Clear Laravel logs
php artisan log:clear

# 2. Clear nginx logs
sudo rm /var/log/nginx/access.log-*
sudo rm /var/log/nginx/error.log-*

# 3. Clear old backups on db-1
sudo find /backups -name "*.sql.gz" -mtime +7 -delete
```

**Still full?** Delete non-essential files but **DO NOT DELETE**:
- `/var/www/` (application)
- `/etc/` (configs)
- `/home/` (user files)

**ESCALATE** if <5% space remains after cleanup.

### 7.4 Backup Failure
1. **Check rclone config:**
   ```bash
   rclone config show
   ```
2. **Test B2 connection:**
   ```bash
   rclone ls backblaze:your-bucket-name/
   ```
3. **Manual backup:**
   ```bash
   mysqldump -u root -p --all-databases | gzip > /backups/manual-$(date +%Y%m%d).sql.gz
   rclone copy /backups/manual-*.sql.gz backblaze:your-bucket-name/db-backups/
   ```
4. **ESCALATE** if B2 inaccessible for 24 hours

### 7.5 Server Unreachable
1. **Go to:** https://console.hetzner.cloud
2. **Navigate:** Projects → Your Project → Servers
3. **Click** on affected server
4. **Click** "Reset" → "Soft Reset" (wait 2 minutes)
5. **Still down?** "Reset" → "Hard Reset" (wait 5 minutes)
6. **Still down?** "Console" tab to see boot messages
7. **ESCALATE** with screenshot of console

## 8. APPENDIX

### 8.1 Critical File Locations
```
app-1:
- App: /var/www/your-app/
- Nginx: /etc/nginx/sites-available/your-app
- PHP: /etc/php/8.2/fpm/php.ini
- Supervisor: /etc/supervisor/conf.d/laravel-worker.conf
- Certbot: /etc/letsencrypt/
- .env: /var/www/your-app/.env

db-1:
- MySQL: /etc/mysql/my.cnf
- Backups: /backups/
- rclone: /home/ubuntu/.config/rclone/rclone.conf
```

### 8.3 Change Freeze Policy
- **No changes** Friday 4 PM → Monday 9 AM
- **No changes** during Dhaka business hours (10 AM-6 PM)
- Always test on https://staging.yourdomain.com first
- Document **every** change in #infrastructure-log Slack channel
